notes: Saturn record 8 (Q10). Correspondence type: game-logic index, CONFIRMED (EXP-0031). In the same selection state the Japanese arcade shows this record and the English arcade shows slot 9 entry 0. Saturn records 0 and 8 both pair with entry 0, because English has 8 entries per character for Japanese's 16. This is not a claim that the English line translates the Japanese: Capcom's English set is a separate rewrite. Reading only, not evidence: entry 4 ('Unless you believe in yourself, you cannot win!') is closer in meaning to this record. Policy (user decision, 2026-10-24): use the official paired English, so preferred_english will be arcade_us_text, filled once GATE-TRANSLATION passes. Table record (RE-021, EXP-0024): decoded MC09.PAC record 8 at WRAM-L 0x0020940C. ps1_us_text is untested (REF-005).
